proseInstruments.name: revolving credit facility
proseInstruments.sourceLine: We are party to a Credit Agreement (the "Credit Agreement") which includes a revolving credit facility ("Credit Facility") of $ 1.25  billion, a $ 15  million swingline sub-facility, a $ 100  million letter of credit sub-facility, as well as uncommitted capacity to incur incremental term loans to finance certain acquisitions up to $ 800  million.

facilitySize.sourceLine: We are party to a Credit Agreement (the "Credit Agreement") which includes a revolving credit facility ("Credit Facility") of $ 1.25  billion, a $ 15  million swingline sub-facility, a $ 100  million letter of credit sub-facility, as well as uncommitted capacity to incur incremental term loans to finance certain acquisitions up to $ 800  million.

available.sourceLine: As of September 30, 2026, we had available borrowing capacity of $1.25 billion under the Credit Facility.

maturity.sourceLine: The Credit Agreement has a term of five years , and all amounts outstanding will be due and payable on November 20, 2030.

seniorityStatement.statement: Each of these notes are senior unsecured obligations of the parent corporation, Molina Healthcare, Inc., and rank equally in right of payment with all existing and future senior debt, and senior to all existing and future subordinated debt of Molina Healthcare, Inc.

results.evidence: 4.375% Notes due June 15, 2028 with $800 million principal amount outstanding as of September 30, 2026.

On November 20, 2025, Molina completed a private offering of $850 million aggregate principal amount of 6.500% senior notes due February 15, 2031. Net proceeds were used to repay $740 million in term loan debt and for general corporate purposes.
results.verifiedQuote: On November 20, 2025, we completed the private offering of $ 850 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes (the " 6.500 % Notes due 2031"), which are due February 15, 2031, unless earlier redeemed.
results.verifiedQuoteNormalized: On November 20, 2025, we completed the private offering of $ 850 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes (the " 6.500 % Notes due 2031"), which are due February 15, 2031, unless earlier redeemed.

issuedTranches.sourceLine: On November 20, 2025 (the "Settlement Date"), Molina Healthcare, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), completed the private offering of $850.0 million aggregate principal amount of the Company's 6.500% Senior Notes due 2031 (the "Notes") pursuant to an indenture, dated as of the Settlement Date, by and between the Company and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee, attached as Exhibit 4.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K (the "Indenture").

results.evidence: No acquisition announced in the current period. The ConnectiCare acquisition closed on February 1, 2025, which is prior to the current reporting period (September 30, 2026).

results.triggerName: Capex program / new facility or construction
results.evidence: No material capex program or new facility construction disclosed. Capital expenditures for property, equipment and capitalized software were $94 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, representing routine maintenance capex rather than a named project or major construction program.
As of September 30, 2026, no amount was outstanding under the $1.25 billion revolving credit facility, with full $1.25 billion available borrowing capacity. The revolver is not near capacity.
In April 2025, the board authorized the purchase of up to $1 billion of common stock through December 31, 2026. As of October 16, 2026, $500 million remained available under this program.
results.verifiedQuote: In April 2025, our board of directors authorized the purchase of up to an additional $1 billion of our common stock. This new program extends through December 31, 2026.
results.verifiedQuoteNormalized: In April 2025, our board of directors authorized the purchase of up to an additional $1 billion of our common stock. This new program extends through December 31, 2026.

results.evidence: Cash and cash equivalents of $4,479 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $4,248 million as of December 31, 2025, representing a $231 million increase quarter over quarter.
results.mappedNeed: Liquidity management, earning on idle cash
results.verifiedQuoteNormalized: dited) ASSETS Current assets: Cash and cash equivalents $4.48 billion $4.25 billion Investments $4.1 billion

results.evidence: No asset sale or divestiture disclosed in the current period. The company exited the MAPD product line effective 2027, but this is a product exit, not an asset sale.

No international expansion disclosed. Molina Healthcare operates exclusively within the United States across 21 states, serving Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace members. No foreign revenue or international operations are mentioned.
No new subsidiary formation disclosed in public filings. New subsidiary formation is typically an internal matter not disclosed unless tied to a reported acquisition.
No IPO or secondary equity offering disclosed. Molina Healthcare is an established public company with no equity issuance activity in the current period.

All outstanding debt as of September 30, 2026 consists of fixed-rate senior notes (4.375%, 3.875%, 6.500%, 3.875%, and 6.250%). No floating-rate debt is outstanding. The revolving credit facility is undrawn.

No material commodity or input-cost exposure disclosed. As a managed healthcare company, Molina's primary cost drivers are medical care costs and pharmacy costs, not commodity inputs. No specific commodity hedging or exposure management is disclosed.

No material foreign-currency exposure disclosed. Molina Healthcare operates exclusively within the United States and has no disclosed foreign operations or foreign-currency denominated assets or liabilities.

results.triggerName: Covenant breach / waiver, or going-concern / liquidity warning
results.evidence: As of September 30, 2026, the company was in compliance with all non-financial and financial covenants under the Credit Agreement. No covenant breach, waiver, going-concern qualification, or liquidity warning is disclosed.
